body:
The current PR looks good to me, though we should work out what we want to do with naming for the config options before we merge this, since that will be difficult to change later on.

I would also like another reviewer to check the macros on the new `KubernetesEvnironmentConfig` struct, since I'm not as familiar with schemars as I'd like to be.

As far as the proposed changes w.r.t putting alises into the environment config itself,  we can either include it in this PR, or merge this (after resolving naming) and have a new PR that includes that functionality. I will leave it to @jankatins to decide which they prefer.

I'm not 100% happy with the body of the module function right now, but I'm also pretty fatigued. Let me get some sleep and get back to you on that.

Everything else looks alright to me, except for the loss of capture groups in the regexes. Is that not implemented just because of additional complexity, or is there some technical blocker that would prevent us from implementing that in the future?

I'm wary of deprecating existing functionality without having a suitable replacement or workaround ready, so if we aren't 100% certain that this can be written without too much hassle, I'm going to be a little nervous about merging this.

:+1: from me, this is looking great!

I'm very happy with this new interface for specifying context-specific styling. Assuming we don't encounter issues with it once it's out in the wild, we might consider porting this into other modules where people have been requesting changes, e.g. in some of the git modules.
